prompt: Users can now choose to get alerts by SMS instead of email; store the choice in a new `User.Channel` property, a `Channel` enum with `Email` and `Sms`, settable when the user is created and email by default. Texts go through `SmsGateway.Send` in Alerts/Gateways.cs, and `App.BuildService` in Alerts/App.cs already receives the gateway. Wire it up.

Users can also choose `Push`, a new `Channel` value: notifications to the app go through `PushGateway.Send(deviceToken, text)` in Alerts/Gateways.cs, and `App.BuildService` already receives that gateway too. Wire it up.
